description: Search one city's places to play tennis: New York City, Melbourne, London, Paris, Toronto, Washington DC, Madrid, Miami, Sydney, Palm Springs, Adelaide, Cincinnati, Tokyo, Los Angeles or Rome. Filter by area (borough, council, district, ward or arrondissement), by name, by how you get on a court, by indoor play, or by minimum court count, and sort by distance from a point. Returns each venue with its page URL. There is no floodlights filter: the records are too sparse to filter on without hiding real lit courts.

access.description: How you get on a court. New York: walk_on (public park, no booking), reservation (public park court bookable through NYC Parks), private_club (runs its own booking). Every other city: walk_on, book (open to the public by booking), members_only, mixed (more than one arrangement at the venue: read its accessDetail), public (the source says public courts and nothing more). A value a city does not use is refused with the ones it does.

area.description: Borough (New York, London), council (Melbourne), arrondissement (Paris), district (Toronto) or ward (Washington DC), exactly as the directory names it, e.g. Manhattan, Camden, Yarra, Scarborough, Ward 3. A name that matches nothing returns the city's valid areas.

borough.description: Same as area. Kept for callers written when the directory was New York only.

city.description: Which city, one of: nyc, melbourne, london, paris, toronto, washington-dc, madrid, miami, sydney, palm-springs-california, adelaide, cincinnati, tokyo, los-angeles, rome (nyc is New York City). Defaults to nyc when left out; the reply says which city it answered for.

indoorOnly.description: Only venues where a source confirms indoor or covered courts, which may be some courts, or winter only: read indoorOrCovered on each. Venues never researched are excluded rather than assumed outdoor.

limit.description: Maximum venues to return. Default 25, maximum 150.

minCourts.description: Minimum number of courts at the venue. Venues whose court count is not sourced are left out when this is set.

name.description: Part of a venue's name, e.g. "central park". Case and accents are ignored.

nearLatitude.description: With nearLongitude: sort by distance from this point, nearest first.

nearLongitude.description: With nearLatitude: sort by distance from this point, nearest first.

name: find_courts
title: Find places to play tennis in one city
